title: Booking an Appointment by Phone
scenario: A patient phones a dental clinic to make an appointment. Listen to the whole call, then answer the questions.
scenarioPersian: یک بیمار به کلینیک دندان‌پزشکی زنگ می‌زند تا وقت بگیرد. کل تماس را گوش بده، بعد به سؤال‌ها جواب بده.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.english: Good morning, Smile Dental Clinic. How can I help you?
lines.persian: صبح بخیر، کلینیک دندان‌پزشکی اسمایل. چه کمکی از من برمی‌آید؟

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.english: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.english: Of course. Do you prefer the morning or the afternoon?
lines.persian: البته. صبح را ترجیح می‌دهید یا بعدازظهر؟

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.english: The afternoon, please. I finish work at four.
lines.persian: بعدازظهر، لطفاً. ساعت چهار کارم تمام می‌شود.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.english: I have a free time on Thursday at half past four.
lines.persian: پنجشنبه ساعت چهار و نیم وقت خالی دارم.

lines.speaker: Caller
lines.english: I'm afraid I can't make it on Thursday. I'm working late. Do you have anything on Friday?
lines.persian: متأسفانه پنجشنبه نمی‌توانم بیایم. تا دیروقت کار می‌کنم. جمعه چیزی دارید؟

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.english: Yes, Friday at five. Is that OK for you?
lines.persian: بله، جمعه ساعت پنج. برایتان خوب است؟

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.english: Can I have your name, please?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.english: Thank you, Mr Rezaei. See you on Friday at five.
lines.persian: ممنون آقای رضایی. جمعه ساعت پنج می‌بینمتان.

exercises.audioText: The afternoon, please. I finish work at four.
exercises.prompt: Why does the caller want the afternoon?
options: They are tired in the morning
The clinic is closed in the morning
exercises.explanation: The caller says: 'I finish work at four.'
exercises.explanationPersian: تماس‌گیرنده می‌گوید: «I finish work at four».

exercises.audioText: I'm afraid I can't make it on Thursday. I'm working late. Do you have anything on Friday?
exercises.prompt: Why can't the caller come on Thursday?

exercises.audioText: Yes, Friday at five. Is that OK for you?
exercises.prompt: What day and time is the appointment?
exercises.explanation: The receptionist offers Friday at five and the caller agrees.
exercises.explanationPersian: منشی جمعه ساعت پنج را پیشنهاد می‌دهد و تماس‌گیرنده قبول می‌کند.

exercises.prompt: What is the caller doing? Answer in a few words.
acceptedAnswers: Making an appointment at the clinic
exercises.explanation: The caller wants to book an appointment.
